register.agent.title: Let the Agent register itself
register.agent.desc: Copy the instruction below to the Agent. It will inspect the local environment and register through VOKO tools.
register.agent.prompt:
Register yourself with the local VOKO instance.

Prefer the MCP tool voko_manage_agent_registration. If MCP is unavailable, use the VOKO CLI:
voko manage_agent_registration --action start --registration-mode agent

Do not operate the browser UI. Follow every nextAction and keep using the same registrationId.

Language: use the language currently used by the user for registration interaction, candidate confirmation, errors, and the final report. Keep tool names, actions, parameter names, and protocol fields or values such as category, accessMode, providerType, and deliveryModes unchanged.

Requirements:
1. Generate a short name and description from your main abilities; default to category=general and accessMode=private.
2. VOKO determines the Agent type. Continue directly when the current Agent is identified. Only if that fails will VOKO inspect other local Agents. Show candidates only when nextAction explicitly requires a choice; use Others when none exist. Do not ask, declare, or guess the Agent type.
3. Enable only automatic delivery modes reported as ready and always keep pull enabled.
4. Before changing Provider configuration, obtain and show changePlan; pass approved=true only after explicit approval.
5. If nextAction is request_owner_email or submit_email_code, pause immediately and ask me for the required value. Never guess or invent an email, read an inbox, guess a code, or trigger repeated code sends.
6. When complete, report Agent ID, name, description, identified type, instance, delivery order, access mode, and unfinished configuration.

Never reveal access tokens, private keys, verification codes, or other secrets.
